description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_EntityParser, which handles referencing and dereferencing of character entities within HTML content. It provides methods for substituting non-special and special entities with their parsed equivalents, utilizing internal lookup tables and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_EntityParser
classes.description: A class that handles referencing and dereferencing character entities in HTML, providing substitution methods for special and non-special entities.

methods.name: substituteNonSpecialEntities
methods.description: Replaces non-special HTML entities in a string with their parsed characters.

methods.name: nonSpecialEntityCallback
methods.description: Callback used by substituteNonSpecialEntities to convert matched entities to their respective characters.

methods.name: substituteSpecialEntities
methods.description: Replaces special HTML entities in a string with their parsed equivalents.

methods.name: specialEntityCallback
methods.description: Callback used by substituteSpecialEntities to convert matched entities to their respective characters.
